E4Plus1.uk.description: Rednecks and Broomsticks: Homer discovers that Cletus and his pals are making moonshine. Lisa gets to know three teenage Wiccans. Guest starring Neve Campbell. (S21 Ep7/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Vulture: Peralta is irked when a detective from Major Crimes takes over a murder case that he's close to solving. Can he prevent the officer from stealing his thunder? (S1 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Halloween: On a very busy Halloween night, Santiago - who hates the holiday - must don fancy dress and go undercover on a street patrol with Boyle. (S1 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Ispy: Claire and Phil decide to spy on Luke and Manny when they're hanging out with one of their more questionable friends. (S5 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Feud: Phil's upset to lose his position of social chair to his nemesis Gil. When he learns that Luke is competing against Gil's kid at wrestling, it becomes a personal battle. (S5 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Spring-a-Ding-Fling: Cameron oversees the school's big spring dance, but when a popular teacher returns from sabbatical, a bit of not-so-friendly competition blooms. (S5 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Other People's Children: It's male-bonding day when Jay takes Luke into the garage to show him how to use tools and impart some manly wisdom. (S5 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Large Marge: Marge accidentally gets breast implants. (S14 Ep4/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Helter Skelter: The Simpsons' house must be fumigated after a hockey player gives Lisa his termite-infested stick. The only place they can find to live is in a reality TV show. (S14 Ep5/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Great Louse Detective: When someone tries to murder Homer, Chief Wiggum seeks help from someone who understands the mind of a killer: Sideshow Bob. (S14 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Special Edna (a.k.a. Love and Marking): When Skinner stands up Mrs Krabappel to attend to his mother's whims, Bart nominates her for Teacher of the Year. (S14 Ep7/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Prince is smitten with Vicky, but does she feel the same? Warren makes a chilling discovery, and Nancy reaches breaking point.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: New Kid on the Block: When Homer gets kicked out of an all-you-can-eat seafood restaurant for eating too much, he takes the owner to court. (S4 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Wedding bells ring for the final couple, and all of the newly-weds jet off to Panama for their honeymoons - together... (S19 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Celebs Go Dating
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Kerry Katona and her boyfriend Paulo return to the agency to talk about their first year together. Stephen and Claira fetch up at a dog cafe. (S15 Ep13/20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers tune in to Bridgerton, SAS: Who Dares Wins, Freeze the Fear with Wim Hof, Made in Chelsea, and the news on Rishi Sunak and the Partygate scandal. (S19 Ep9)

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Corruption: Exploring the evolution of Auschwitz and how it related to the Nazis' campaign of extermination. Corruption was rife among the SS officers working at the camp. S1 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Rise of the Nazis
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Night of the Long Knives: The infamous Night of the Long Knives in late June and early July of 1934, when Adolf Hitler ordered a series of political executions on those seen as a threat. S1 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Blackpool 1: The team visit Lancashire, where they examine items in the Blackpool Tower Ballroom, including a Bible containing handwritten extracts by Charlotte Bronte. S32 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Marple to Huddersfield: Robbie Cumming continues across the Pennines from Marple to Huddersfield, where his journey is hampered by a fallen tree and a leaking lock pound. S1 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Sowerby Bridge to Manchester: Robbie Cumming travels along the Rochdale Canal from Sowerby Bridge to Manchester, but disaster strikes when he runs aground. S1 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Train Truckers
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Heavy Haul Train: A CBD80 battery-powered loco needs to be hauled 20 miles from a factory in Burton-on-Trent to the heritage Chasewater Railway in Staffordshire. S2 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: The Gamble: Adam leaves his home waters in search of Dover sole hoping to cover his ever-growing expenses, and Stephen breaks from the fleet towards stormy weather in Scotland. S1 Ep5

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Austin Gipsy / Toyota MR2 Ferrari: Derek heads to Scotland in a rainstorm to pick up a Jaguar E-type and a rare MGC convertible, and Dave extracts a rare Austin Gipsey from a lock-up. S5 Ep3
